qa_pairs.question: What is the part number for removing and installing or replacing acceleration pick-up?
How do you remove the acceleration pick-up plug?
qa_pairs.answer: Pull off plug (1). Remove shear-off screws (only drilling out is approved).

qa_pairs.question: What adjustment is required during installation of the acceleration pick-up?
What is the part number for checking acceleration pick-up for ABS?
What test lead should be connected when checking the acceleration pick-up for ABS?
qa_pairs.answer: Connect Jetronic test lead 61 1 440 on acceleration pick-up.

qa_pairs.question: What ohmmeter model is specified for testing the acceleration pick-up?
qa_pairs.answer: Connect ohmmeter (M 06) of BMW service tester.

qa_pairs.question: What is the nominal resistance value for the acceleration pick-up switch?
What connections should be measured when checking the switch with wire and plug?
What is the nominal resistance value when measuring between connections 1 and 16?
What must be turned off while measuring resistance?
qa_pairs.answer: Ignition must be turned off while measuring.

qa_pairs.question: What callout number indicates the acceleration pick-up plug in both procedures?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout number 1 indicates the acceleration pick-up plug in both the removal/installation and checking procedures.

qa_pairs.question: What universal adapter is mentioned for connecting to the ABS control unit wire harness?
qa_pairs.answer: Connect universal adapter on wire harness from ABS control unit, with a source reference to HWB.
